6aaadf258cc64f2b2b7dbe3c: Ichigo must travel into the depths of Hell to save his younger sister Yuzu.
Ichigo and his fellow Soul Reapers must save two worlds from annihilation.
After the treasured Ouin is stolen, Toshiro Hitsugaya disappears and becomes suspected of treason.
A secret police force known as the Black Guard protects the boundary between the human world and the demon world.
A young warrior battles against a city overtaken by demons, one devil at a time. To save Tokyo from evil, he must defeat a sinister psychic from the underworld.

Ghiaccio's Stand, White Ice is able to envelop him like a bodysuit and able to freeze everything around him to extremely low temperatures. Giorno and Mista somewhat make it to Venice, despite being partially frozen by Ghiaccio...

By revealing to each other a fearless embrace of the unknown, Giorno and Mista emerge victorious against Ghiaccio. Now, a single member of Bruno’s group must face a single bell tower, a single elevator shaft, and a single menacing task.

In the crypt of a Venetian church, Bruno discovers not only the brutal truth behind the Boss’s true intentions but also the unstoppable Stand power he wields, a power that leaves Bruno in a pool of blood and in a moral quandary.
Peer into the complex personal pasts of Bucciarati and his fellow gang members, and uncover the thread that unites this diverse group of fighters into a single team and single expression of resolve.

Bruno and team, now self-chosen traitors, learn from Trish during a moment of calm at a Venetian café a trip to Sardegna is vital. Chaos, then, erupts as Narancia loses his tongue and ability to speak the truth.

As Giorno is teleported between puddles with Squalo’s shark attached firmly to his jugular, Narancia tries to sniff out the perpetrator using his CO2 tracer but is inhibited by Tiziano’s tongue-fusing Stand, frustrating himself and Bruno’s team.

Bruno et al head to Marco Polo airport to venture to Sardegna to discover the truth behind Trish’s father. On the tarmac, however, is a swollen, neckless Stand user who, the team discovers while airborne, is linked to the freshly severed fingers onboard

At cruising altitude, Trish faces a voracious and fleshy mass of a Stand that strikes at the slightest movement. Meanwhile, Giorno’s incessantly pulsating broach, the key to the team’s survival, lies waiting—as does an unseen force within Trish.

Bruno and team make an emergency landing in Sardegna where the Hitman Team leader, Risotto, is also determined to uncover a certain mystery. Doppio, a timid, wide-eyed teen, the result of a seemingly impossible pregnancy, has his own goals on the island.

Having discovered there is more to skittish Doppio than meets the eye, Risotto uses his Stand to manifest various metallic instruments of torture from within his enemy. Fortunately for Doppio, a way to foresee the inevitable offers a glimmer of hope.

A picturesque Sardinian cliff becomes the bloody backdrop to Doppio’s sudden dominance over Risotto, courtesy of Narancia’s own Stand. On the beach below, Abbacchio works to rewind time 15 years to identify the identity of a certain photographer.
Witness destiny unfold for Trish and the rest of Bruno’s team as her father’s cryptic presence and arcane abilities pull the crew into battles of unspeakable brutality.
With Abbacchio’s replaying ability interminably stamped in stone, Bruno and team analyze the cryptic face and fingerprints left behind when a mysterious call arrives.

No sooner than Bruno and team set foot on the shore near Rome the team finds a flesh-eating mold devouring everyone in sight. It's the work of Cioccolata, made worse by his partner Secco, who records the tortured faces of his victims to be viewed later.

Branching off from Bruno, who opts to tackle the underground swimmer Secco, Giorno and Mista chase Cioccolata as he flies to spread rotten ruin upon Rome. Their battles unfold in front of a mystery ally silently awaiting their arrival at the Colosseum.

Donald tem uma surpresa que o faz repensar a maneira como trata Lilly. Sam se arrepende de suas decisões. Hunter faz sua primeira reunião de gabinete, porém ela não ocorre como Donald queria.

Barry sente que sua vida está em perigo. Victoria se empenha em arruinar a vida de Sam. Priscilla continua investigando um crime que pode ter acontecido na Casa Branca.
Kaleb está pressionando Jazmine para transar com ele pela primeira vez, mas Calvin se envolve na situação.
Jazmine diz a Kaleb que não está pronta pra transar.
Malik e Lisa tem uma discussão feia.
Miranda vistia Ella na esperança de encontrar Calvin.
Calvin exige que a familia não tenha contato com Miranda.
Ella descobre que Malik e Lisa tem grandes questões, e Ella chega a um novo limite com Curtis.
Os moradores competem por um prêmio em dinheiro no Ark Tank, uma iniciativa da comunidade para fazer os idosos inventarem soluções para a melhoria da comunidade.
Depois de Cora se esforçar muito para fazer com que os moradores do Dias Felizes participem de algumas atividades, uma nova residente chega e dá um pouco de vida à cada um deles.
O Sr. Brown assiste "verdade nua e crua" e jura que nunca mais vai comer carne até que fica sozinho com muitos pratos tentadores.
Um show de talentos revela aos moradores do Dias Felizes partes deles mesmos e de suas relações que precisam ser observadas e consertadas.
O par do baile de formatura de Sandra a abandona no último minuto, então os moradores da casa de repouso decidem fazer um baile só para ela na casa.
Jeremy e Leah planejam uma cerimônia para renovar os seus votos.
Um morador do Dias Felizes demonstra imensa generosidade ao resto dos inquilinos antes de deixá-los.
Reginald busca o perdão do seu filho afastado.

Gary força uma conversa com Andi. Zac é perseguido por outra trama romântica. Mais tarde, Gary se embriaga e sua raiva transborda.
Sabrina e Danni ficam receosas uando se lembram como foi difícil afastar Andi de seu namorado abusivo na faculdade. Fatima fica sabendo que Hayden está ameaçando Zac.
